title: feat: add polli update command for global CLI installs
author: davealan74
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #14879

## Summary
- Adds `polli update`, which delegates to `npm install -g @pollinations/cli@latest` for global installs
- Detects npx-cache and local/project installs and prints instructions instead of creating a second global install (no sudo, no silent updates, no generic updater framework)
- Preserves existing output conventions: human messages on stderr, structured `--json` result on stdout, non-zero exit on failure
- Adds `polli update` to README and the CLI skill quick-reference table

## Test plan
- `npx vitest run` in `packages/polli-cli` — all 116 tests pass (5 new for `detectInstallKind`)
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — no new errors in touched files
- `npx biome check --write` on touched files — clean
- Manually verified end-to-end against the real npm registry using isolated npm prefixes (no interference with any real global install):
  - Packed the CLI, installed it globally into an isolated `--prefix`, pinned to an old version, ran `polli update` — it detected the global install, ran `npm install -g @pollinations/cli@latest`, and confirmed the prefix now has the latest published version
  - Installed the CLI the way npx does (into a `_npx` cache-style directory) and ran `polli update` — printed the npx guidance, made no changes
  - Ran the CLI straight from a local checkout (not under `npm root -g`) and ran `polli update` — printed the local-install guidance, made no changes

gist.headline: Polli learns to molt
gist.blurb: The CLI can now tend its own global install with `polli update`. If it finds an npx cache or a project-local copy, it politely explains the situation instead of planting a second CLI in your machine.
gist.summary: Added `polli update` to globally installed `@pollinations/cli`, which runs `npm install -g @pollinations/cli@latest` while detecting npx-cache and local/project installs and providing the appropriate guidance instead.
gist.impact: Global CLI users can update with one command, while npx and local-install users get clear next steps without a sudo prompt, silent update, or accidental second global installation.
